import re
files=sorted(list(Path('main').glob('*.c'))+list(Path('main').glob('*.h')))

for p in files:

    for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1):
        if any(x in l for x in ('xTaskCreate(', 'xQueueCreate(', 'xQueueCreateStatic(')):
            print(f'{p}:{i}:{l.strip()}')

sites=[]

            sites.append((str(p),i,l.strip()))

assert any(p.endswith('gateway_events.c') for p,_,_ in sites)

assert not any(p.endswith('gateway_uart_link.c') for p,_,_ in sites)

alloc=[]
pat=re.compile(r'\b(malloc|calloc|realloc|free)\s*\(')
for p in files:

        if pat.search(l):
            alloc.append((str(p),i,l.strip())); print(f'{p}:{i}:{l.strip()}')
assert not alloc, alloc

assert 'gateway_link_snapshot_cache_update' in uart
